Name: Togepi dog replacement
Author: alreadytakenBS
Description:
I made this for a friend who had selected the dog, even though it would probably fit more as a cat replacement. (Hearing it Bark is hilarious though)

I took the sprites from this page and redrew one or two: http://www.spriters-resource.com/game_boy_advance/pmd/sheet/38651/
So credits to Mighty Jetters for them.

You can put the folder "content" in your stardew valley folder and let it replace the file. ( you might want to back up your file first though).

Mods.ManifestParseErrorText: it's not a SMAPI mod (see https://smapi.io/xnb for info).
